          echo SEMAPRAX_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER=%SEMAPRAX_ARCHIVER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_MSVC_LINKER=%SEMAPRAX_LINKER%>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo LINK=>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
          echo _LINK_=>>"%GITHUB_ENV%"
      - name: Resolve the held Clang image (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $clang = (Get-Command clang.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($clang)) { throw "clang path is not absolute" }
          "CLANG=$clang" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Provision the native HTTPS development interface (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libcurl4-openssl-dev
      - name: Fetch the complete locked workspace dependency closure
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Fetch the standalone owned-data Rust setup dependency closure
        run: cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/owned-data-rust/Cargo.toml
      - name: Fetch standalone lockfile-check dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          plan_args=(--plan-only)
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]]; then
            plan_args+=(--exclude-package semaprax-native-rust-interop --exclude-package semaprax-harness)
          fi
          plan_json="$(python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py "${plan_args[@]}")"
          if python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin); s=next((x for x in p["shards"] if x["name"]==sys.argv[1]), {"targets":[]}); sys.exit(0 if any(t["name"]=="standalone_lockfiles" for t in s["targets"]) else 1)' '${{ matrix.shard }}' <<<"$plan_json"; then
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/calculator-rust/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path examples/embedding-api/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path crates/semaprax-native-rust-interop-builder/src/public_sdk/fixtures/ri09-reqwest/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path platform-tests/component-runtime/Cargo.toml
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path platform-tests/public-scalar-wit-interface/Cargo.toml
          fi
          # The shard planner moves test targets between shards as the suite
          # grows, so the static reference service is built for whichever
          # shard actually runs semaprax-native-host's runtime_host target.
          if python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin); s=next((x for x in p["shards"] if x["name"]==sys.argv[1]), {"targets":[]}); sys.exit(0 if any(t["name"]=="runtime_host" for t in s["targets"]) else 1)' '${{ matrix.shard }}' <<<"$plan_json"; then
            echo "SEMAPRAX_SHARD_RUNS_REFERENCE_SERVICE=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
      - name: Build the static Linux reference service for its packaging acceptance
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.SEMAPRAX_SHARD_RUNS_REFERENCE_SERVICE == '1'
        shell: bash
        env:
          CC_x86_64_unknown_linux_musl: musl-gcc
          CARGO_NET_OFFLINE: "true"
          RUSTFLAGS: -C relocation-model=static
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends musl-tools
          rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          cargo build --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl \
            -p semaprax-native-host --bin semaprax-reference-service
          executable="$PWD/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/debug/semaprax-reference-service"
          test -x "$executable"
          readelf -h "$executable" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*Type:[[:space:]]+EXEC[[:space:]]+'
          if readelf -l "$executable" | grep -q INTERP; then
            echo 'reference service unexpectedly has a dynamic interpreter' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SEMAPRAX_TEST_REFERENCE_SERVICE_STATIC_EXECUTABLE=$executable" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Test the complete workspace target shard (Unix)
        id: workspace_target_shard_unix
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_KERNEL_ZERO_RUNG_TWO_TARGETS: "1"
          SEMAPRAX_REQUIRE_RESUMABLE_BACKENDS: "1"
        run: python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py --label "Rust $RUNNER_OS" --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}" --nocapture
      - name: Preserve the exact macOS unit executable for bounded replay
        id: macos_unit_replay
        if: always() && runner.os == 'macOS' && matrix.shard == 'unit' && steps.workspace_target_shard_unix.outcome == 'failure'
        shell: bash
        run: python3 scripts/ci-unit-artifact.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-unit-replay"
      - name: Upload the current macOS unit replay artifact
        if: always() && steps.macos_unit_replay.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: semaprax-unit-macos-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/semaprax-unit-replay
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Capture task-service frontend bytes after a failed owning shard
        if: failure() && runner.os != 'Windows' && matrix.shard == 'integration-0' && steps.workspace_target_shard_unix.outcome == 'failure'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --locked --offline -p semaprax --all-features --test useful_data \
            task_service_project::task_service_frontend_byte_audit -- \
            --exact --ignored --nocapture
      - name: Test the complete workspace target shard without duplicate Windows native interop
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $split = @()
          if ('${{ matrix.shard }}' -eq 'integration-3') { $split = @('--split-windows-agent-runtime') }
          python3 scripts/ci-msrv.py --label "Rust Windows" --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}" --exclude-package semaprax-native-rust-interop --exclude-package semaprax-harness --nocapture @split

        run: cargo fetch --locked

    steps:
      # Seatbelt enforcement is a property of a real macOS kernel. Nothing on a
      # Linux runner can stand in for it, which is why this is its own job
      # rather than a step in an existing matrix: a skipped step reads as a
      # pass, and the whole point of the contract in
      # docs/DOCTOR-PRODUCTION-PROVISIONER-MACOS-V1.md is that a denial must be
      # observed, not assumed.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false

        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - name: Fetch the locked dependency closure
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if cargo fetch --locked; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $((attempt * 15))
          done
          exit 1

  release-artifacts:
    name: Release artifact (${{ matrix.target }})
    # `success()` is written explicitly rather than relied on implicitly: a
    # bare tag-prefix condition with no status function is still ANDed with
    # `success()` by GitHub today, but that insertion is undocumented
    # behaviour this workflow must not depend on silently. Say what is meant:
    # this job never runs unless `release-gate` -- the exact-tag blocking
    # gate -- has already succeeded in this same run.
    if: ${{ success() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
    needs: release-gate
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 240
    # Each producer attests its own smoke-tested archive. The OIDC and
    # attestation capabilities are intentionally scoped here rather than
    # inherited by ordinary CI jobs or the aggregate release gate.
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
          - os: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            extension: zip
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Guarded here rather than with a step-level runner condition:
          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e2a55d2ffb04f378e9626c28d38b36d230d1e12f # master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - name: Build, package, and smoke-test the Unix release artifact
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: bash
        run: scripts/package-release.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$GITHUB_SHA" "${{ matrix.target }}" dist
      - name: Build, package, and smoke-test the Linux release artifact in the glibc 2.35 baseline container
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: scripts/package-release-linux-container.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$GITHUB_SHA" "${{ matrix.target }}" dist
      - name: Build, package, and smoke-test the Windows release artifact
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: scripts/package-release.ps1 -Tag $env:GITHUB_REF_NAME -Commit $env:GITHUB_SHA -Target "${{ matrix.target }}" -OutputRoot dist
      - name: Run the archive product harness against the exact packaged archive
        shell: bash
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          package="semaprax-v$version-${{ matrix.target }}"
          unpacked="$RUNNER_TEMP/archive-product"
          mkdir "$unpacked"
          # Unpacked outside the checkout, from the archive bytes themselves.
          if [ "${{ matrix.extension }}" = zip ]; then
            python3 -m zipfile -e "dist/$package.zip" "$unpacked"
          else
            python3 -m tarfile -e "dist/$package.tar.gz" "$unpacked"
          fi
          SEMAPRAX_RELEASE_ROOT="$unpacked/$package" SEMAPRAX_RELEASE_COMMIT="$GITHUB_SHA" \
            cargo test --locked -p semaprax --test release_archive_product_v1 -- \
            --ignored provisioned_archive_cli_and_daemon_work_outside_checkout --exact --nocapture
      - name: Attest the exact smoke-tested target archive
        id: attest-release-archive
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: dist/semaprax-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.extension }}
      - name: Stage the exact target attestation bundle for release publication
        shell: bash
        env:
          ATTESTATION_BUNDLE: ${{ steps.attest-release-archive.outputs.bundle-path }}
          RELEASE_BUNDLE: dist/release-attestation-${{ matrix.target }}.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$ATTESTATION_BUNDLE"
          test -f "$ATTESTATION_BUNDLE"
          cp -- "$ATTESTATION_BUNDLE" "$RELEASE_BUNDLE"
          test -s "$RELEASE_BUNDLE"
      - name: Retain the exact target archive for aggregate publication
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: |
            dist/semaprax-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.extension }}
            dist/release-attestation-${{ matrix.target }}.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          compression-level: 0

  release-candidate:
    name: Release candidate metadata
    # Assembles the exact SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json publication
    # will carry, from the exact archives the producers attested, so the
    # install journey below can consume candidate bytes through the
    # installers' normal download path before anything is public.
    # publish-release regenerates both and refuses to publish unless they
    # are byte-identical to these.
    if: ${{ success() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
    needs: release-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Download every exercised target archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: release-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Assemble the candidate SHA256SUMS and release manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          archives=(
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
          )
          for archive in "${archives[@]}"; do
            test -f "dist/$archive"
          done
          cp scripts/install.sh scripts/install.ps1 dist/
          (cd dist && sha256sum "${archives[@]}" install.sh install.ps1) > dist/SHA256SUMS
          python3 scripts/release-manifest.py \
            --version "$version" \
            --tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --archives-dir dist \
            --output dist/release-manifest.json
          mkdir candidate-metadata
          cp dist/SHA256SUMS dist/release-manifest.json candidate-metadata/
      - name: Retain the candidate metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: candidate-metadata
          path: candidate-metadata
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  release-install-journey:
    name: Release install journey (${{ matrix.target }}, ${{ matrix.shell }})
    # The distribution boundary: each target's exact attested archive goes
    # through the tagged installer's normal download path (file:// staging of
    # the candidate bytes), into a fresh user prefix whose path contains a
    # space, then the beginner journey, daemon handshake, reinstall, a
    # damaged-archive control and uninstall (docs/INSTALLER-V1.md). Linux runs
    # in a bare ubuntu:22.04 container: the declared glibc 2.35 baseline with
    # no Rust, Clang, Node or checkout toolchain on the execution path.
    # Publication requires every cell.
    if: ${{ success() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
    needs: release-candidate
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            extension: tar.gz
            shell: sh
          - os: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            extension: zip
            shell: powershell
          - os: windows-2025
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            extension: zip
            shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Download this target's exact attested archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: candidate
      - name: Download the candidate metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: candidate-metadata
          path: candidate
      - name: Stage the tagged installers beside the candidate assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp scripts/install.sh scripts/install.ps1 candidate/
          ls -la candidate
          # A source-checkout binary must never stand in for the archive.
          test ! -e candidate/semaprax
      - name: Verify the target archive's publisher attestation
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh attestation verify "candidate/semaprax-$GITHUB_REF_NAME-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.extension }}" \
            --bundle "candidate/release-attestation-${{ matrix.target }}.json" \
            --repo wavect/semaprax \
            --signer-workflow wavect/semaprax/.github/workflows/ci.yml \
            --source-ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
            --deny-self-hosted-runners
      - name: Linux journey in the glibc 2.35 baseline container
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run --rm -e GITHUB_REF_NAME \
            -v "$PWD/scripts/install-journey.sh:/journey.sh:ro" \
            -v "$PWD/candidate:/candidate:ro" \
            ubuntu:22.04 sh -c '
              set -eu
              apt-get update -qq >/dev/null
              apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates >/dev/null
              getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION
              cp -R /candidate /tmp/candidate
              sh /journey.sh /tmp/candidate "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
            '
      - name: macOS journey (publisher verification required)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: bash
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_JOURNEY_REQUIRE_PUBLISHER: "1"
        run: sh scripts/install-journey.sh "$PWD/candidate" "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - name: Windows PowerShell 5.1 journey (publisher verification required)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.shell == 'powershell'
        shell: powershell
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_JOURNEY_PUBLISHER_VERIFY: "1"
        run: |
          & ./scripts/install-journey.ps1 -AssetsDir "$PWD\candidate" -Tag $env:GITHUB_REF_NAME
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: PowerShell 7 journey (publisher verification required)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.shell == 'pwsh'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SEMAPRAX_JOURNEY_PUBLISHER_VERIFY: "1"
        run: |
          & ./scripts/install-journey.ps1 -AssetsDir "$PWD\candidate" -Tag $env:GITHUB_REF_NAME
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

  publish-release:
    name: Publish tag release
    if: ${{ startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && success() }}
    needs:

      - release-artifacts

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      # Sigstore keyless signing mints a short-lived Fulcio certificate from

      # archive producers have separate, equally scoped OIDC tokens solely for
      # their GitHub provenance attestations; no ordinary job has either.
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Allow Windows to check out long evidence paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Guarded here rather than with a step-level runner condition:
          # tests/native_rust_interop_ci_contract.rs pins the exact number of
          # Windows-gated steps in the Public SDK job, and this one is
          # incidental to that contract's subject.
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = Windows ]; then
            git config --system core.longpaths true
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
      - name: Confirm this checkout is the exact tag commit the release gate accepted
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Download every exercised target archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: release-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Stage the tagged installers verbatim as release assets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Published byte-identical to the tagged sources; the same bytes the
          # release-install-journey matrix already installed from.
          test ! -e dist/install.sh
          test ! -e dist/install.ps1
          cp scripts/install.sh scripts/install.ps1 dist/
          cmp scripts/install.sh dist/install.sh
          cmp scripts/install.ps1 dist/install.ps1
      - name: Authenticate the complete archive inventory and produce SHA256SUMS
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          archives=(
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz"
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
          )
          attestations=(
            "release-attestation-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.json"
            "release-attestation-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.json"
            "release-attestation-aarch64-apple-darwin.json"
            "release-attestation-x86_64-apple-darwin.json"
            "release-attestation-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.json"
          )
          test "$(find dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'semaprax-*' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "${#archives[@]}"
          for archive in "${archives[@]}"; do
            test -f "dist/$archive"
          done
          test "$(find dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'release-attestation-*.json' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "${#attestations[@]}"
          for attestation in "${attestations[@]}"; do
            test -s "dist/$attestation"
          done
          # Freeze the root before the first aggregate verification so every
          # archive/bundle pair is checked against the exact root published
          # with this release. `--bundle` prevents a different API-fetched
          # attestation from standing in for the retained one.
          test ! -e dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          gh attestation trusted-root \
            | head -c 4194305 > dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test -s dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test "$(wc -c < dist/trusted_root.jsonl | tr -d ' ')" -le 4194304
          for index in "${!archives[@]}"; do
            archive="${archives[$index]}"
            attestation="${attestations[$index]}"
            gh attestation verify "dist/$archive" \
              --bundle "dist/$attestation" \
              --custom-trusted-root dist/trusted_root.jsonl \
              --repo wavect/semaprax \
              --signer-workflow wavect/semaprax/.github/workflows/ci.yml \
              --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --source-ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
              --deny-self-hosted-runners
          done
          (cd dist && sha256sum "${archives[@]}" install.sh install.ps1) > dist/SHA256SUMS
          test "$(wc -l < dist/SHA256SUMS | tr -d ' ')" = "$(( ${#archives[@]} + 2 ))"
      - name: Generate the final release manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          python3 scripts/release-manifest.py \
            --version "$version" \
            --tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --archives-dir dist \
            --output dist/release-manifest.json
          test -s dist/release-manifest.json
      - name: Download the candidate metadata the install journey consumed
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: candidate-metadata
          path: candidate
      - name: Confirm publication carries exactly the tested candidate metadata
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # release-install-journey installed every target from these exact
          # SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json bytes; publishing anything
          # else would publish untested metadata.
          cmp candidate/SHA256SUMS dist/SHA256SUMS
          cmp candidate/release-manifest.json dist/release-manifest.json
      - name: Generate release provenance from the final manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "$tag" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          python3 scripts/release-provenance.py \
            --manifest dist/release-manifest.json \
            --workflow-identity "wavect/semaprax/.github/workflows/ci.yml@refs/tags/$tag" \
            --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --run-attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            --rustc-version "$(rustc --version)" \
            --host-class github-hosted-ubuntu-24.04 \
            --output dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
      - name: Install pinned cosign
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f17788090df1f26f669e9d70d6ae9567deba6 # v4.1.2
        with:
          cosign-release: v3.1.3
      - name: Sign final release provenance with keyless Sigstore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s dist/release-manifest.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
          cosign sign-blob --yes \
            --bundle dist/release-provenance.bundle \
            dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.bundle
      - name: Derive the signature claim after archive-attestation verification
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.bundle
          test ! -e dist/release-signature-claim.json
          test -s dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test "$(wc -c < dist/trusted_root.jsonl | tr -d ' ')" -le 4194304
          python3 scripts/release-signature-claim.py \
            --provenance dist/release-provenance.json \
            --bundle dist/release-provenance.bundle \
            --output dist/release-signature-claim.json
          python3 scripts/release-signature-claim.py \
            --provenance dist/release-provenance.json \
            --bundle dist/release-provenance.bundle \
            --check dist/release-signature-claim.json
          test -s dist/release-signature-claim.json
      - name: Independently verify the signed release before publication
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          package="semaprax-$GITHUB_REF_NAME-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
          archive="dist/$package.tar.gz"
          test -s "$archive"
          test ! -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify"
          # Stream only the exact smoke-tested CLI member, never extract the
          # archive's remaining paths into the publisher filesystem.
          tar -xOzf "$archive" "$package/semaprax" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify"
          chmod 0500 "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify"
          root_digest="$(sha256sum dist/trusted_root.jsonl | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/semaprax-release-verify" doctor verify-release dist \
            --trusted-root-sha256 "$root_digest"
      - name: Publish the release archives only after complete aggregation
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          test -n "$version"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$version"
          python3 scripts/release-notes.py --version "$version" --assets-dir dist > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          test -s dist/release-manifest.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.json
          test -s dist/release-provenance.bundle
          test -s dist/release-signature-claim.json
          test -s dist/trusted_root.jsonl
          test -s dist/release-attestation-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-aarch64-apple-darwin.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-x86_64-apple-darwin.json
          test -s dist/release-attestation-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.json
          # A superseded tag run must never replace the current release assets.
          test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME^{}" | cut -f1)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          assets=(
            dist/semaprax-* dist/SHA256SUMS
            dist/release-manifest.json dist/release-provenance.json
            dist/release-provenance.bundle dist/release-signature-claim.json
            dist/trusted_root.jsonl
            dist/release-attestation-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
            dist/release-attestation-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.json
            dist/release-attestation-aarch64-apple-darwin.json
            dist/release-attestation-x86_64-apple-darwin.json
            dist/release-attestation-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.json
            dist/install.sh dist/install.ps1
          )
          if gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${assets[@]}" --clobber
            gh release edit "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --prerelease=false \
              --title "SEMAPRAX $GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          else
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "${assets[@]}" \
              --verify-tag \
              --title "SEMAPRAX $GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
          fi
      - name: Confirm the published download URLs resolve (read-only)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Bounded, read-only discoverability check; it never deletes or
          # edits a release. A failure here is reported for a human to act on.
          version=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          base="https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/releases/download/$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          for asset in install.sh install.ps1 SHA256SUMS release-manifest.json \
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" \
            "semaprax-v$version-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"; do
            ok=0
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
              if curl -fsSIL --max-time 30 -o /dev/null "$base/$asset"; then ok=1; break; fi
              sleep 10
            done
            test "$ok" = 1 || { echo "published asset does not resolve: $asset" >&2; exit 1; }
          done

This adapter deliberately does not reuse the Claude JSONL accounting: Codex's

def harness_source_inventory(repo: Path = REPO, relative_files: tuple[str, ...] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Hash the complete local source closure used by the matched campaign."""
    root = repo.resolve(strict=True)
    inventory: dict[str, str] = {}
    for relative in (HARNESS_SOURCE_FILES if relative_files is None else relative_files):
        source = root / relative
        if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"campaign harness source is not a regular file: {relative}")
        try:
            source.resolve(strict=True).relative_to(root)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ValueError(f"campaign harness source escapes repository: {relative}") from error
        inventory[relative] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return inventory


def snapshot_harness_sources(repo: Path, artifacts: Path, expected: dict[str, str],
                             frozen_spec_sha256: str, *, relative_files: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
                             spec_path: str = "benchmarks/cli-tokens-v1/SPEC.md") -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Copy only the pinned harness closure and verify every retained byte."""
    current = harness_source_inventory(repo) if relative_files is None else harness_source_inventory(repo, relative_files)
    if current != expected:
        raise ValueError("campaign harness source changed after the immutable plan")
    destination = artifacts / "harness-source"
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError("campaign harness source snapshot must be new")
    destination.mkdir(parents=True)
    for relative, wanted in current.items():
        source = repo / relative
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        contents = source.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest() != wanted:
            raise ValueError(f"campaign harness source changed while snapshotting: {relative}")
        target.write_bytes(contents)
    for relative, wanted in current.items():
        copied = destination / relative
        if hashlib.sha256(copied.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != wanted:
            raise ValueError(f"campaign harness source snapshot hash differs: {relative}")
    snapshot = {
        "schema": "semaprax.codex-harness-source-snapshot.v1",
        "path": "harness-source",
        "files_sha256": current,
        "frozen_spec": {
            "path": spec_path,
            "sha256": frozen_spec_sha256,
            "source": "seed_files_sha256",
        },
    }
    (destination / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return snapshot


def _sha256(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
    if (not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64
            or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a lowercase SHA-256 digest")
    return value


def _regular_path(path: str | Path, label: str) -> Path:
    """Return a lexical absolute regular path after rejecting every symlink."""
    if not isinstance(path, (str, Path)):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} path must be text")
    absolute = Path(path).expanduser().absolute()
    if any(component == ".." for component in absolute.parts):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} path must not contain parent traversal")
    current = Path(absolute.anchor)
    for component in absolute.parts[1:]:
        current /= component
        if current.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"{label} must not be a symlink or have symlinked parents")
    if not current.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a regular file")
    return current


def _bounded_regular_bytes(path: Path, label: str) -> bytes:
    if path.stat().st_size > MAX_COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_BYTES:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} exceeds {MAX_COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_BYTES} bytes")
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        contents = source.read(MAX_COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_BYTES + 1)
    if len(contents) > MAX_COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_BYTES:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} exceeds {MAX_COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_BYTES} bytes")
    return contents


def _digest_regular(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(HASH_CHUNK_BYTES), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _compiler_build_receipt(path: str | Path, compiler_source_commit: str,
                            compiler_binary_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bind a planned binary to retained external build-log bytes.

    A caller-supplied receipt establishes byte bindings only. It does not prove
    that a hosted provider built or published the selected compiler.
    """
    if not isinstance(compiler_source_commit, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", compiler_source_commit):
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt requires an exact compiler source commit")
    _sha256(compiler_binary_sha256, "compiler build receipt binary")
    receipt_path = _regular_path(path, "compiler build receipt")
    try:
        receipt = json.loads(_bounded_regular_bytes(receipt_path, "compiler build receipt"))
    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt must be UTF-8 JSON") from error
    required = {"schema", "compiler_source_commit", "compiler_binary_sha256", "build_command", "build_log"}
    if not isinstance(receipt, dict) or set(receipt) != required or receipt.get("schema") != COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt has an unsupported schema")
    if receipt.get("compiler_source_commit") != compiler_source_commit:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt source differs from --compiler-source-ref")
    if receipt.get("compiler_binary_sha256") != compiler_binary_sha256:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt binary differs from --semaprax-bin")
    command = receipt.get("build_command")
    if (not isinstance(command, list) or not command
            or any(not isinstance(argument, str) or not argument.strip() or "\x00" in argument
                   for argument in command)):
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt command must be a nonempty argument array")
    build_log = receipt.get("build_log")
    if not isinstance(build_log, dict) or set(build_log) != {"path", "sha256"}:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt must bind one build log")
    relative_log = build_log.get("path")
    relative_log_path = Path(relative_log) if isinstance(relative_log, str) else None
    if (relative_log_path is None or not relative_log_path.parts or relative_log_path.is_absolute()
            or any(component in {".", ".."} for component in relative_log_path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt build log path must be relative")
    log_path = _regular_path(receipt_path.parent / relative_log_path, "compiler build receipt build log")
    log_sha256 = _sha256(build_log.get("sha256"), "compiler build receipt build log")
    if _digest_regular(log_path) != log_sha256:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt build log hash differs")
    return {
        "schema": COMPILER_BUILD_RECEIPT_SCHEMA,
        "receipt_path": str(receipt_path),
        "receipt_sha256": _digest_regular(receipt_path),
        "compiler_source_commit": compiler_source_commit,
        "compiler_binary_sha256": compiler_binary_sha256,
        "build_command": command,
        "build_log_path": str(log_path),
        "build_log_sha256": log_sha256,
        "provenance": "caller-supplied external build receipt; hosted build and publication provenance require operator verification",
    }


def require_compiler_build_receipt(settings: dict[str, Any], semaprax_bin: Path) -> None:
    """Refuse dispatch when the retained external build binding has drifted."""
    planned = settings.get("compiler_build_receipt")
    if not isinstance(planned, dict):
        raise ValueError("future LogLens campaign requires a compiler build receipt")
    source = settings.get("compiler_source_commit")
    binary_sha256 = settings.get("source_binary_sha256")
    if not isinstance(source, str):
        raise ValueError("campaign plan must bind the compiler source commit")
    _sha256(binary_sha256, "campaign compiler binary")
    actual = _compiler_build_receipt(planned.get("receipt_path", ""), source, binary_sha256)
    if actual != planned:
        raise ValueError("compiler build receipt differs from the immutable campaign plan")
    if legacy.digest(semaprax_bin.expanduser().resolve(strict=True)) != binary_sha256:
        raise ValueError("compiler binary differs from the immutable campaign plan")


def _usage(value: Any) -> dict[str, int | None]:
    names = ("input_tokens", "cached_input_tokens", "cache_write_input_tokens", "output_tokens", "reasoning_output_tokens")
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return {name: None for name in names}
    return {
        name: value.get(name) if type(value.get(name)) is int and value[name] >= 0 else None
        for name in names
    }


def _same_usage(left: dict[str, int | None], right: dict[str, int | None]) -> bool:
    return all(left.get(name) == right.get(name) for name in left)


def codex_command(prompt: str, model: str = MODEL, effort: str = EFFORT) -> list[str]:
    """Use only explicit, symmetric configuration; do not replace HOME/CODEX_HOME."""
    return [
        "codex", "exec", "--json", "--model", model, "--sandbox", "workspace-write",
        "--ignore-user-config", "--ignore-rules",
        "--disable", "apps", "--disable", "plugins", "--disable", "memories",
        "--disable", "multi_agent", "--disable", "skill_search",
        "--config", f'model_reasoning_effort="{effort}"',
        "--config", "web_search='disabled'", "--", prompt,
    ]


def capabilities(binary: str = "codex") -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A no-model-call preflight of the installed CLI's advertised exec flags."""
    completed = subprocess.run([binary, "exec", "--help"], text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    required = ("--json", "--model", "--sandbox", "--ignore-user-config", "--ignore-rules", "--disable", "--config")
    help_text = completed.stdout + completed.stderr
    return {
        "status": "ready" if completed.returncode == 0 and all(flag in help_text for flag in required) else "unsupported",
        "binary": binary, "exit_code": completed.returncode,
        "required_flags": {flag: flag in help_text for flag in required},
        "configuration": {
            "user_config": "ignored", "rules": "ignored",
            "disabled_features": ["apps", "plugins", "memories", "multi_agent", "skill_search"],
            "web_search": "disabled", "home_overridden": False, "codex_home_overridden": False,
        },
    }


def parse_exec_jsonl(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read the final outer-turn total without treating tool items as turns."""
    completed: list[dict[str, int | None]] = []
    tool_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    invalid = 0
    thread_ids: list[str] = []
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        try:
            event = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            invalid += 1
            continue
        if not isinstance(event, dict):
            invalid += 1
            continue
        if event.get("type") == "turn.completed":
            completed.append(_usage(event.get("usage")))
        if event.get("type") == "item.completed":
            item = event.get("item")
            kind = item.get("type") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
            if isinstance(kind, str):
                tool_counts[kind] = tool_counts.get(kind, 0) + 1
        thread = event.get("thread_id") or event.get("threadId")
        if isinstance(thread, str) and thread not in thread_ids:
            thread_ids.append(thread)
    return {
        "final_turn_usage": completed[-1] if len(completed) == 1 else None,
        "turn_completed_events": len(completed),
        "codex_outer_turns": len(completed),
        "tool_item_counts": tool_counts,
        "thread_ids": thread_ids,
        "invalid_stream_lines": invalid,
        "model_observed": None,
        "model_identity_note": "The exec JSONL does not expose an observed model identity.",
        "stable_context_tokens": None,
    }


def _rollout_records_with_integrity(
    path: Path,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str], list[str], int | None, int, int]:
    requests: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    models: list[str] = []
    efforts: list[str] = []
    context_window: int | None = None
    seen: set[str] = set()
    malformed_lines = 0
    orphan_usage_records = 0
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        try:
            event = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            malformed_lines += 1
            continue
        if not isinstance(event, dict):
            malformed_lines += 1
            continue
        payload = event.get("payload")
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            if event.get("type") == "token_usage_record":
                orphan_usage_records += 1
            continue
        if event.get("type") == "turn_context":
            for value, sink in ((payload.get("model"), models), (payload.get("effort"), efforts)):
                if isinstance(value, str) and value not in sink:
                    sink.append(value)
        if event.get("type") == "token_usage_record":
            usage = _usage(payload.get("usage"))
            identity = payload.get("response_id") or payload.get("turn_id")
            if not isinstance(identity, str) or not identity.strip():
                orphan_usage_records += 1
                continue
            key = json.dumps([identity, usage], sort_keys=True)
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                requests.append({"request_id": identity, "usage": usage})
        if event.get("type") == "event_msg" and payload.get("type") == "token_count":
            info = payload.get("info")
            if isinstance(info, dict) and isinstance(info.get("model_context_window"), int):
                context_window = info["model_context_window"]
    return requests, models, efforts, context_window, malformed_lines, orphan_usage_records


def _rollout_records(path: Path) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str], list[str], int | None]:
    """Compatibility projection of rollout records without integrity counters."""
    requests, models, efforts, context_window, _, _ = _rollout_records_with_integrity(path)
    return requests, models, efforts, context_window


def trace_usage(exec_usage: dict[str, Any], rollout: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    requests, models, efforts, context_window, malformed_lines, orphan_usage_records = (
        _rollout_records_with_integrity(rollout)
    )
    final = exec_usage.get("final_turn_usage")
    summed: dict[str, int | None] = {}
    for name in _usage({}):
        values = [request["usage"][name] for request in requests]
        summed[name] = sum(values) if values and all(value is not None for value in values) else None
    reconciled = (
        isinstance(final, dict)
        and all(value is not None for value in final.values())
        and _same_usage(final, summed)
        and malformed_lines == 0
        and orphan_usage_records == 0
    )
    return {
        "model_requests": requests if reconciled else [],
        "model_request_count": len(requests) if reconciled else None,
        "model_observed": models[0] if reconciled and len(models) == 1 else None,
        "effort_observed": efforts[0] if reconciled and len(efforts) == 1 else None,
        "model_context_window": context_window,
        "model_identity_source": "client turn_context; provider-resolved model is unavailable",
        "provider_resolved_model": None,
        "legacy_net_input_tokens": (sum(r["usage"]["input_tokens"] for r in requests) - requests[0]["usage"]["input_tokens"] * len(requests)) if reconciled and requests and all(r["usage"]["input_tokens"] is not None for r in requests) else None,
        "legacy_net_note": "Codex input includes cache subsets; subtract first request total once per model request for historical comparability only, never task-only input.",
        "request_usage_sum": summed,
        "final_turn_usage": final,
        "reconciled": reconciled,
        "rollout_malformed_lines": malformed_lines,
        "rollout_orphan_usage_records": orphan_usage_records,
        "reconciliation_note": "Per-request trace sum must equal final turn.completed usage; tool item counts are separate.",
    }


def telemetry_valid(observed: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return (observed.get("reconciled") is True
            and observed.get("model_observed") == MODEL
            and observed.get("effort_observed") == EFFORT
            and observed.get("invalid_stream_lines") == 0)


def list_price_estimate(requests: list[dict[str, Any]], price_book: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Conditional standard-price estimate; actual billing and cache-write amount remain unknown."""
    # Compatibility calls use the explicitly dated historical card, never a
    # claim about today's price. Live/recount routes pass their saved card.
    card = ({"date": "2026-10-08", "standard_short_context_usd_per_million": PRICE_USD_PER_MTOK}
            if price_book is None else price_book)
    prices = card.get("standard_short_context_usd_per_million") if isinstance(card, dict) else None
    date = card.get("date") if isinstance(card, dict) else None
    card_valid = (isinstance(date, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", date) is not None
        and isinstance(prices, dict) and set(prices) == set(PRICE_USD_PER_MTOK)
        and all(isinstance(rate, (int, float)) and not isinstance(rate, bool)
                and math.isfinite(rate) and rate >= 0 for rate in prices.values()))
    amount, writes = 0.0, 0
    valid = bool(requests) and card_valid
    if not card_valid:
        requests = []
    for request in requests:
        known = _usage(request.get("usage"))
        if not all(known[key] is not None for key in ("input_tokens", "cached_input_tokens", "cache_write_input_tokens", "output_tokens")):
            valid = False; break
        uncached = known["input_tokens"] - known["cached_input_tokens"] - known["cache_write_input_tokens"]
        if uncached < 0 or known["input_tokens"] > SHORT_CONTEXT_LIMIT:
            valid = False; break
        writes += known["cache_write_input_tokens"]
        amount += (uncached * prices["input"] + known["cached_input_tokens"] * prices["cache_read"] + known["cache_write_input_tokens"] * prices["cache_write"] + known["output_tokens"] * prices["output"]) / 1_000_000
        if not math.isfinite(amount):
            valid = False; break
    return {
        "standard_short_context_api_equivalent_usd": round(amount, 6) if valid else None,
        "assumptions": "each request input <=272k; input/cache-read/cache-write/output use published standard rates",
        "actual_billed_usd": None, "cache_write_tokens": writes if valid else None,
        "cache_write_cost_usd": round(writes * prices["cache_write"] / 1_000_000, 6) if valid else None,
        "reason": None if valid else "missing/invalid dated rate card, per-request usage, bucket subset, or short-context threshold",
    }


def run_codex(command: list[str], workspace: Path, env: dict[str, str], stream: Path, stderr: Path, timeout: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Retain both logs and terminate the process group on timeout; never retry quota failures."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    with stream.open("wb") as output, stderr.open("wb") as errors:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=workspace, env=env, stdout=output, stderr=errors, start_new_session=True)
        timed_out = False
        try:
            code = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                code = process.wait(timeout=15)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                code = process.wait()
    return {"process_exit_code": code, "timed_out": timed_out, "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)}


def plan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    repo = Path(args.repo).resolve(strict=True)
    commit = legacy.resolve_commit(repo, args.base_ref)
    compiler_source_commit = legacy.resolve_commit(repo, args.compiler_source_ref)
    hashes = legacy.pinned_seed_hashes(repo, commit)
    legacy.validate_round_identity(ROUND, hashes)
    qualification = legacy.qualification.metadata()
    frozen_spec_hash = hashes["benchmarks/cli-tokens-v1/SPEC.md"]
    if frozen_spec_hash != qualification["spec_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("future campaign frozen SPEC differs from boundary qualification")
    harness_sources = harness_source_inventory()
    artifacts = Path(args.artifacts).expanduser().resolve()
    try:
        artifacts.relative_to(repo)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise ValueError("artifact directory must be outside the repository")
    if artifacts.exists():
        raise ValueError("artifact path must not already exist")
    if args.model != MODEL or args.effort != EFFORT:
        raise ValueError("matched campaign pins gpt-6.1-sol at medium effort")
    if args.trials_per_arm < MIN_TRIALS_PER_ARM or args.timeout_seconds != TIMEOUT_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError("matched campaign requires five trials per arm and a 1800-second timeout")
    binary_sha256 = legacy.digest(Path(args.semaprax_bin).resolve(strict=True))
    receipt_arg = getattr(args, "compiler_build_receipt", None)
    if not receipt_arg:
        raise ValueError("future LogLens campaign requires --compiler-build-receipt")
    compiler_build_receipt = _compiler_build_receipt(
        receipt_arg, compiler_source_commit, binary_sha256,
    )
    tooling = None
    if getattr(args, "typescript_bootstrap_receipt", None):
        receipt_path = Path(args.typescript_bootstrap_receipt).expanduser()
        if receipt_path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("TypeScript bootstrap receipt must not be a symlink")
        resolved_receipt = receipt_path.resolve(strict=True)
        if receipt_path.absolute() != resolved_receipt:
            raise ValueError("TypeScript bootstrap receipt path must not traverse symlinked parents")
        receipt_path = resolved_receipt
        receipt = ts_bootstrap.validate(receipt_path, args.node_binary, args.npm_binary)
        tooling = {"receipt_path": str(receipt_path), "receipt_sha256": legacy.digest(receipt_path),
                   "inventory_sha256": receipt["inventory_sha256"], "runtime": receipt["runtime"],
                   "package_json_sha256": receipt["package_json_sha256"],
                   "package_lock_sha256": receipt["package_lock_sha256"],
                   "packages": receipt["packages"], "helper_sha256": receipt["helper_sha256"],
                   "dependency_helper_sha256": receipt["dependency_helper_sha256"],
                   "node_binary": args.node_binary,
                   "npm_binary": args.npm_binary}
    settings = {
        "adapter": "codex-matched-loglens-v1", "round": ROUND, "repository_commit": commit,
        "compiler_source_commit": compiler_source_commit,
        "seed_files_sha256": hashes, "artifacts": str(artifacts), "model_requested": args.model,
        "harness_source_snapshot": {
            "schema": "semaprax.codex-harness-source-snapshot.v1",
            "path": "harness-source",
            "files_sha256": harness_sources,
            "frozen_spec": {
                "path": "benchmarks/cli-tokens-v1/SPEC.md",
                "sha256": frozen_spec_hash,
                "source": "seed_files_sha256",
            },
        },
        "qualification": qualification,
        "effort_requested": args.effort, "timeout_seconds": args.timeout_seconds,
        "trial_order": [arm for index in range(args.trials_per_arm) for arm in (ARMS if index % 2 == 0 else tuple(reversed(ARMS)))],
        "authored_source_tokenizer": legacy.tokenizer_metadata(args.tokenizer_dir),
        "typescript_bootstrap": tooling,
        "typescript_setup_context_tokens": None,
        "codex_binary": args.codex_binary,
        "codex_version": subprocess.run([args.codex_binary, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip(),
        "price_book": {"date": "2026-10-08", "source": "https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol", "standard_short_context_usd_per_million": PRICE_USD_PER_MTOK, "conditional": True},
        "attempt_denominator": args.trials_per_arm * len(ARMS),
        "resource_policy": resources.policy(),
        "source_binary_sha256": binary_sha256,
        "compiler_build_receipt": compiler_build_receipt,
        "calibration": {"prompt": CALIBRATION_PROMPT, "separate": True, "subtracted_from_trials": False},
        "measurement": {"stable_context_tokens": None, "legacy_net_input_tokens": None,
                        "model_request_count": "trace-backed only; never inferred from item counts"},
        "capabilities": capabilities(args.codex_binary),
    }

    if getattr(args, "selected_file_resource_v1", False):
        settings["selected_file_setup"] = selected_file_setup.capability(Path(args.semaprax_bin).resolve(strict=True))
    return settings


def copy_task_rollout(thread_ids: list[str], workspace: Path, destination: Path,
                      sessions_root: Path | None = None) -> Path | None:
    """Read only the exact CLI-emitted thread, authenticated by ID and cwd."""
    if len(thread_ids) != 1 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f-]{36}", thread_ids[0]):
        return None
    root = sessions_root if sessions_root is not None else common.codex_sessions_root()
    paths = list(root.rglob(f"*{thread_ids[0]}.jsonl"))
    if len(paths) != 1:
        return None
    raw_lines = paths[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    try:
        records = [json.loads(raw) for raw in raw_lines]
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return None
    metas = [r.get("payload", {}) for r in records if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("type") == "session_meta"]
    if len(metas) != 1 or metas[0].get("id") != thread_ids[0] or not isinstance(metas[0].get("cwd"), str):
        return None
    if Path(metas[0]["cwd"]).resolve() != workspace.resolve():
        return None
    def redact(value: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {key: redact(item) for key, item in value.items()
                    if key.lower() not in {"creator_user", "creator_user_id", "creator_account_id", "account_id", "user_id", "email"}}
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [redact(item) for item in value]
        return value
    destination.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(redact(r), sort_keys=True) for r in records) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return destination


def _command(settings: dict[str, Any], prompt: str) -> list[str]:
    command = codex_command(prompt)
    command[0] = settings["codex_binary"]

def cleanup_trial(repo: Path, workspace: Path, settings: dict[str, Any], row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    guard, failure = legacy.trial_workspace_guard(workspace, settings)
    row["workspace_integrity_before_cleanup"] = guard

                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)

    if removed.returncode:
        row["workspace_retained_for_review"] = True
        row["cleanup_error"] = legacy.bounded_text(removed.stderr)


@resources.guarded_attempt
def launch_trial(repo: Path, artifacts: Path, commit: str, trial: dict[str, Any], settings: dict[str, Any], semaprax_bin: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run one paid attempt. Every attempted trial remains in the result denominator."""

@resources.guarded_attempt

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    preflight = sub.add_parser("capabilities", help="inspect CLI support without a model request")

        current.add_argument("--effort", default=EFFORT); current.add_argument("--trials-per-arm", type=int, default=MIN_TRIALS_PER_ARM)
        current.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=int, default=TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    run_parser.add_argument("--acknowledge-paid-attempts", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        result = capabilities(args.codex_binary) if args.action == "capabilities" else plan(args)
        if args.action == "run":
            if not args.acknowledge_paid_attempts:
                raise ValueError("run requires --acknowledge-paid-attempts")

            require_compiler_build_receipt(result, Path(args.semaprax_bin))

            seed = legacy.create_seed_repository(Path(args.repo).resolve(), result["repository_commit"], artifacts / "seed-repository")
            result.update(seed); result["semaprax_binary"] = str(Path(args.semaprax_bin).resolve())
            (artifacts / "campaign.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
            calibration = launch_calibration(artifacts / "seed-repository", artifacts, seed["seed_repository_commit"], result, Path(args.semaprax_bin).resolve())
            (artifacts / "calibration.json").write_text(json.dumps(calibration, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
            if calibration["status"] != "ready":

                      "accepted": sum(row.get("status") == "accepted" for row in rows),
                      "failed_or_rejected_attempts": sum(row.get("status") != "accepted" for row in rows)}

        return 0 if result.get("status", "ready") in {"ready", "completed"} else 2
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f"codex campaign error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
